title: List view: Create work items with Rovo
description: We've updated the empty state in the list view for Jira Software and business projects to help you get started faster. If your site has Atlassian Rovo enabled, you'll now see a Rovo-first landing state when a list is empty. This change allows you to quickly generate multiple work items using Rovo or use an enhanced inline creation form with AI-powered suggestions, making it easier to populate your project and organize your work.
